description: Field recording of the Torrente Pettorina at Boscoverde, near Rocca Pietore in the Belluno Dolomites, Italy. Recorded laterally from the bank, with the torrent flowing past the microphone rather than directly toward it. This perspective emphasizes the continuous movement of the current across the stereo field, with layers of rushing water, smaller splashes and turbulence around the rocks. Recorded with a Zoom H1essential — see if you can spot it hiding somewhere in the photo :)
name: Mountain Stream Flowing Past from the Riverbank, Boscoverde, Dolomites - Torrente Pettorina
